Use case: precise-object-edit. Produce exactly ONE full square transparent RGBA native >=1024 sprite, editing image 1 only. This is the ice sword girl's NE run frame 04 between images 2 (NE03) and 3 (NE05), each 75ms. Image4 is the primary approved soft polished hand-painted Daoist chibi style only.
CHANGE ONLY BOTH SHOULDER-SLEEVE-ELBOW-WRIST CHAINS AND THEIR HELD OBJECT POSITIONS into a genuine halfway running-arm pose. In image2 the anatomical RIGHT sword hand is on the forward/right side; in image3 it is fully backward/left. Image1 currently jumps to the backward endpoint too early. Put frame04's right elbow and sword grip halfway between those two endpoints, close to the near waist/hip with a natural bent elbow, not fully extended backward. The sword must stay gripped by the same anatomical RIGHT hand. The sword blade should be passing smoothly through a LOWERED intermediate orientation, broadly downward in clear space outside the thighs, instead of abruptly pointing fully left as image3. Keep sword shape and blade length unchanged; no detached hand, floating hilt or blade through a leg.
Move the anatomical LEFT talisman arm only halfway from image2's rear position toward image3's forward position: the left elbow, sleeve and blue rectangular talisman stay closer to the far torso and can be partially occluded, not at full forward reach. Preserve a continuous shoulder-to-upperarm-to-elbow-to-wrist chain, one sword in right hand, one talisman in left hand.
LOCK EVERYTHING ELSE TO IMAGE1: exact head/face/brown highbun and long hair, blue-white-gold costume, pelvis, hips, both thighs, knees, shins, ankles, boot shapes and positions, leg lengths, anatomy, camera NE facing, body position and full-canvas scale. The anatomical LEFT support boot remains planted in exactly its old position; anatomical RIGHT free leg remains lifted and bent exactly as image1. Do not move or redraw the lower body while fixing arms. Hips-to-thigh-to-knee-to-shin-to-ankle-to-toe must remain in the original coherent NE travel plane, no toe-out/splayed stance. Preserve current natural perspective and raised-sole view. Maintain two arms, two legs, one sword, one talisman. Full character in same framing, no crop, no recentering, no resizing, no mirror, no text, no scene, no shadow, no grid. True alpha transparency.
